source_author: John G. Fernald / Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco
sector: US business sector (same sector and same vintage for both series)

variables.dLP: Business labor productivity: dY - dhours; output per hour
variables.dtfp_util: Business TFP adjusted for factor utilization: dtfp - dutil
variables.dY: Average of expenditure-side and income-side real business output growth (when both available)

units: Percent annualized log changes: 400 * change in natural log (workbook readme row 13)
transformation: Index_t = 100 * exp(sum(growth_q for q > 2022Q4 and q <= t) / 400); no interpolation, extrapolation or smoothing
interpretation: The gap includes capital deepening, labor composition and utilization. It is not a causal estimate of data-center investment or AI effects. TFP is a measured residual, not a pure technology measure.
validation: Require complete contiguous quarterly sample; verify dLP = dY - dhours and dLP - dtfp_util = alpha*(dk-dhours) + (1-alpha)*dLQ + dutil
